'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Wojtek Wisniewski LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Wojciech Wisniewski|Wojtek Wisniewski]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Wojciech Wisniewski|Wojtek Wisniewski]]
